text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a gain felt rewarding, but I should trim or hold according to a pre-set valuation and allocation plan, not the satisfaction of locking in gains.","My account moved up and down while I made no trades; since past price changes do not predict future ones, I should not treat short-term moves or frequent account checks as trading signals.","Before adding to several stocks, I should assess total portfolio risk, diversification, and cash needs, and avoid investing more simply because prices have fallen."]}
